title: DAGR Analytics Metric Snapshot v0.1
description: A derived, replaceable metric value over one bounded window, with inspectable provenance (Constitution A12; Orientation §22–23).

input_partition_digest.description: Binds the snapshot to the canonicalized content of the bounded input partition (see algorithm).

metric_definition_digest.description: Binds the snapshot to the canonicalized parsed metric-definition object (see algorithm). Makes a changed definition under the same version visible.

$comment: CANONICALIZATION PROFILE (v0.1): canonical JSON is dagr.canonical-json.v0.1 (counterpedia lib/activity/canonicalJson.ts) — UTF-8, Unicode code-point key ordering, RFC 8785 / ECMAScript deterministic number serialization, no insignificant whitespace, finite-number enforcement. C1 does NOT mint a second analytics canonicalizer. C1's digest domain is narrowed (ASCII event_id + ASCII context keys + integer-only scalar context values) so this profile is provably byte-exact cross-language over C1's inputs (the profile's code-point key sort is exact only on the ASCII domain; integer-only numbers remove ECMAScript-vs-Python float divergence). Given that domain, sorted-keys/compact-separators/UTF-8 serialization is byte-equivalent to the profile. Digest algorithms (v0.1, candidate). Canonical JSON everywhere = keys sorted lexicographically, UTF-8, separators (',',':'), no whitespace, no trailing newline; digest = 'sha256:' + hex(sha256(canonical)). (1) metric_definition_digest = digest over the parsed metric definition object (contracts/metrics/metric_definition.v0_1.schema.json instance), canonicalized. (2) input_partition_digest = digest over {observations, window_end, window_start} where observations is the full partition's observation objects sorted by event_id ascending, each object canonicalized. event_id MUST be unique within the bounded partition; a duplicate event_id makes the partition INVALID, derivation MUST fail closed, and no metric snapshot may be emitted. The digest is a property of the partition and is identical across all metrics in the same window. (3) snapshot_digest = digest over body {derivation_version, input_partition_digest, metric_definition_digest, metric_id, metric_version, value, window_end, window_start}. snapshot_digest therefore changes if the input partition OR the canonicalized definition object OR the count changes — two partitions with the same count no longer collide, and a changed definition under the same version is no longer invisible. privacy_class and snapshot_digest itself are excluded from the body. Any implementation MUST reproduce these exactly.
